title: Internal-external attention switching SEEG epochs, DMN and DAN channels, 25 epilepsy patients (Hammer et al. 2024)
description: Stereo-EEG epochs from 25 patients with drug-resistant epilepsy performing a task that alternated between external attention (visual search) and internal attention (questions about personal experiences). Epochs span -4 to +4 s around each task switch and are limited to bipolar channels assigned to the default mode network and dorsal attention network by the Yeo-7 atlas. The data are the authors' preprocessed epochs from the original study of antagonistic network dynamics mediated by low-frequency oscillations, repackaged in iEEG-BIDS format.
methods_description: SEEG was recorded with DIXI Medical depth electrodes and Quantum/NeuroWorks amplifiers at 2048 Hz, with reference and ground in white matter. The authors downsampled the data to 512 Hz, removed channels in pathological tissue, and bipolar-referenced along each shank. They then applied a 0.1 Hz high-pass filter and a 50 Hz notch filter with harmonics, and cut epochs around task switches. Contacts were localised on post-implantation CT coregistered to MRI and normalised to MNI space with SPM12. The release does not state the physical unit of the data; channels are labelled µV as an assumption by the dataset curators, not a statement by the original authors.
